newsitem.title: SPAIN: Telefonica 's sale price 3,389 ptas maximum.
newsitem.headline: Telefonica 's sale price 3,389 ptas maximum.

text.p: The maximum share price in the upcoming sale of Spain's remaining 21 percent stake in telecoms operator Telefonica de Espana will not exceed 3,389 pesetas, according to the limits set out in the prospectus.
The maximum will be set by the state holding company SEPPa on Monday and cannot be higher than the highest average price in the five previous trading sessions.
Telefonica's average share price this week ranged from 3,239 pesetas on Monday to 3,248 on Tuesday, 3,288 on Wednesday, 3,333 on Thursday and 3,389 on Friday.
The final subscription period for the offer opens on February 11 at 0730 GMT and closes on February 14 at 1300 GMT.
The final price will be set on February 17.
